theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.far_commute_unconditional {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (hSL : SimplyLaced M) {i j : B} (hm : M.M i j = 2) (h : R) (v : W → R) :
HeckeGeneral.mulStep (commutingTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Di h (HeckeGeneral.mulStep (commutingTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Dj h v) = HeckeGeneral.mulStep (commutingTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Dj h (HeckeGeneral.mulStep (commutingTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Di h v)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.braid_unconditional {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (hSL : SimplyLaced M) {i j : B} (hm : M.M i j = 3) (h : R) (v : W → R) :
HeckeGeneral.mulStep (dihedralTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Di h (HeckeGeneral.mulStep (dihedralTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Dj h (HeckeGeneral.mulStep (dihedralTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Di h v)) = HeckeGeneral.mulStep (dihedralTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Dj h (HeckeGeneral.mulStep (dihedralTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Di h (HeckeGeneral.mulStep (dihedralTransversal' cs i j hm ⋯).Dj h v))

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.simple_ne_of_simplyLaced {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (hSL : SimplyLaced M) {i j : B} (hij : i ≠ j) :
cs.simple i ≠ cs.simple j

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.geomRep_simple {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (hSL : SimplyLaced M) (i : B) :
(geomRep cs hSL) (cs.simple i) = reflEnd M i

noncomputable def QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.geomRep {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (hSL : SimplyLaced M) :
W →* Module.End ℝ (B →₀ ℝ)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.reflEnd_isLiftable_of_simplyLaced {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} (hSL : SimplyLaced M) :
M.IsLiftable (reflEnd M)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.reflEnd_braid_of_eq_three {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {i j : B} (hne : i ≠ j) (hm : M.M i j = 3) :
(reflEnd M i * reflEnd M j) ^ 3 = 1

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.reflEnd_comm_of_eq_two {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {i j : B} (hne : i ≠ j) (hm : M.M i j = 2) :
reflEnd M i * reflEnd M j = reflEnd M j * reflEnd M i

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.reflEnd_mul_self {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i : B) :
reflEnd M i * reflEnd M i = 1

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.formLin_reflEnd_self {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i : B) (v : B →₀ ℝ) :
(formLin M i) ((reflEnd M i) v) = -(formLin M i) v

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.reflEnd_apply {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i : B) (v : B →₀ ℝ) :
(reflEnd M i) v = v - Finsupp.single i (2 * (formLin M i) v)

noncomputable def QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.reflEnd {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i : B) :
Module.End ℝ (B →₀ ℝ)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.formLin_single {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i j : B) (c : ℝ) :
(formLin M i) (Finsupp.single j c) = bilinCoeff M i j * c

noncomputable def QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.formLin {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i : B) :
(B →₀ ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.bilinCoeff_of_eq_three {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {i j : B} (hne : i ≠ j) (hm : M.M i j = 3) :
bilinCoeff M i j = -(1 / 2)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.bilinCoeff_of_eq_two {B : Type u_1} {M : CoxeterMatrix B} {i j : B} (hne : i ≠ j) (hm : M.M i j = 2) :
bilinCoeff M i j = 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.bilinCoeff_symm {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i j : B) :
bilinCoeff M i j = bilinCoeff M j i

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.bilinCoeff_diag {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i : B) :
bilinCoeff M i i = 1

noncomputable def QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.bilinCoeff {B : Type u_1} (M : CoxeterMatrix B) (i j : B) :
ℝ
